_comment: real wrappers in src/control/services/secrets.ts read these shapes;
`source` is the field that matters here. A debug build reads the key from
the OPENAI_API_KEY environment variable AHEAD of the OS credential store,
because macOS ties a Keychain item's ACL to the requesting binary's code
signature and `tauri dev` presents a new one on every rebuild. With two
possible sources, a status that only says `present: true` cannot tell the
operator which key is billing their account — so the source crosses the
What must NEVER appear in any object below is the key itself. `hint` is the
last four characters and nothing else; `source` names a drawer, not a value.
A release build can only ever emit `keychain` or `none`.
_absent_omits_hint_comment: `hint` is skipped when there is no key (serde skip_serializing_if), so the
absent status is three keys short of the others — asserting on it pins the
omission as well as the `none` source.
